verdict.rationale: Financial Connections has background building blocks: webhooks fire when balance, ownership and transaction refreshes complete, and when accounts are newly linked. The use-cases docs also list agent-powered balance and transaction monitoring via the Link CLI, and a community report mentions daily data pulls. Developers still have to build the automation themselves, and there is no documented user-facing way to configure autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling or automation configuration feature, documented autonomous agent workflows beyond a one-line use-case mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background agent operation.
